description: Use this when the user describes the Set they want in words, or wants a Set inside a known Family, and icons are needed. Not for a name the user typed (`find_sets_by_name`). Next: `search_assets` with the chosen `slug` as `setSlug`. Semantic search for Sets by natural-language query: discovers Sets by meaning, not by substring on the stored name. Optionally scoped with `familySlug` to narrow results to a specific Family. For substring / partial name match on stored names, use `find_sets_by_name` instead — these do different things and must not be confused. Use `get_all_sets_from_family` when you already know the Family and want the full list with no search intent.

familySlug.description: When set, only return Sets belonging to this Family. Use the Family slug from `search_families` (`familySlug`) or `get_all_families` (`slug`).

limit.description: Maximum number of Sets to return (default: 20, max: 100).

productType.description: Only when the user names the product type: "icons", "illustrations" or "elements", or asks for emojis, stickers or backgrounds, which are "elements" even when the user calls them icons. Then only Sets of that type are searched. Leave it out otherwise, and when you pass `familySlug`: the Family already decides it.

query.description: Natural-language search term to find Sets. Preserve full intent (questions, negatives); do not compress into comma-separated keyword stacks unless the user only gave keywords. Do not append tastes or UI goals the user did not say. For avoid / steer-clear asks, keep the traits the user rejected central rather than padding with positives you inferred.

name: search_sets

next_step.description: What to do instead, when the search found nothing.
